$comment: What you key on your side of a Contest run (#320): your CQ, your sign-off and each smart-box send. Shared fixture, consumed by ios MorseKitCheck, android QSOSelfKeyingTest and desktop QSOSelfKeyingTest. Data, not code; see CLAUDE.md's separate-ports rule.

derivation.cq: per exchange: singleCaller 'CQ CQ DE {call} {call} K'; pota 'CQ POTA DE {call} {call} K'; basicContest 'CQ TEST {call} {call}'; cwt 'CQ CWT {call}'; sst 'CQ SST {call}'; mst 'CQ MST {call}'; sprint 'CQ NS {call}'; fieldDay 'CQ FD {call} {call}'
derivation.send: trim and upper-case the typed text, then the first rule that applies: a QRS request -> 'QRS PSE'; QRQ -> 'QRQ'; empty or a repeat request (?, AGN, AGN?, QRZ) -> 'AGN?'; the send moved the run into working from a phase that was neither working nor readyToLog -> '{working call} 5NN' (the typed fragment when no station is being worked); working before and after (a miss) -> 'AGN?'; readyToLog after -> 'R'; otherwise the typed text as a query, with '?' added when it does not already end in one
derivation.phases: idle, pileup, working, readyToLog: PileupEngine.Phase before and after the send, without the station id
derivation.note: The spec is the iOS AppModel behaviour Pileup Runner and Contest have keyed since before this fixture (selfCQText, the TU, selfSendText), written out by hand from the rules above.

cq.text: CQ CQ DE N9HO N9HO K
CQ POTA DE N9HO N9HO K
